1333169.quote: Most of the comments that humans are providing are actually not about bugs or correctness. It's about decisions.
1333169.claim: Human review comments are mostly about decisions, not bugs or correctness.
1333169.speaker: Ankit Jain

1333169.quote: It's for us to build mental models.
1333169.claim: Code review exists to build a team's shared mental model, and line-by-line review of large AI diffs no longer does that.
1333169.speaker: Ankit Jain

1333169.quote: Everything that they disagree about, we should write it down.
1333169.claim: A coding agent and a review agent with opposing goals should argue first, and every disagreement should be recorded as a decision.
1333169.speaker: Ankit Jain

1333169.quote: Intent is why are we making whatever change.
1333169.claim: Intent and acceptance criteria, captured from the agent session, replace hand-maintained specs that go stale.
1333169.speaker: Ankit Jain

1333169.quote: Out of 200 candidates, we got 64 rules automatically created.
1333169.claim: Mining past review comments yields rules (invariants) with owners, and some of them become deterministic checks.
1333169.speaker: Ankit Jain

1333169.quote: So instead of thinking about owning the code. Own the guardrails. Own the rules.
1333169.claim: Humans stay accountable by owning the rules and guardrails that verify code, not the lines of code.
1333169.speaker: Ankit Jain

1334565.quote: Go to market is one of the few remaining sources of alpha
1334565.claim: As software becomes a commodity, go-to-market is one of the few remaining sources of advantage, and Monaco's product is world-class go-to-market knowledge and procedure.
1334565.speaker: Mihail Eric

1334565.quote: there are principles and primitives that are true to any vertical company, vertical AI company.
1334565.claim: Every vertical AI company builds the same harness: data access, an agent workspace with memory, expert-guided workflows and evaluation; what differs is the domain nuance layered on top.
1334565.speaker: Mihail Eric

1334565.quote: This is where we developed a concept called reflections
1334565.claim: The memory system is seeded from emails, call transcripts and onboarding context, and a reflection process promotes what agents learn about users and organisations back into it, so the system changes daily.
1334565.speaker: Mihail Eric

1334565.quote: you know better than we do how to sell to dentists in the Midwest
1334565.claim: Workflows come in two modes: opinionated ones Monaco builds from its own sales expertise, and custom agents customers build for their own niche through an agent builder.
1334565.speaker: Mihail Eric

1334565.quote: Absolute correctness is only correctness informed by subject matter experts.
1334565.claim: In vertical AI correctness is contextual and defined by subject matter experts, so evaluations are set by in-house experts and every agent run is traced; traces are treated as gold.
1334565.speaker: Mihail Eric

1334565.quote: So we are the first. Customers of our own system
1334565.claim: Monaco sells Monaco with Monaco, embeds its best salespeople in the product team and makes traces visible to everyone, closing the gap between domain experts and engineers.
1334565.speaker: Mihail Eric

1341863.quote: Attackers are obviously using agents to attack you.
1341863.claim: Attackers already use agents, so defense has to run on agents too.
1341863.speaker: Karan Vaidya

1341863.quote: And it's running twenty four into seven, so engineers can somewhat sleep effectively while.
1341863.claim: Security agent swarms watch company activity around the clock and queue uncertain findings for a person to judge in the morning.
1341863.speaker: Karan Vaidya

1341863.quote: A few minutes after deploy, the song suggests that there is a rollback in the trade itself and slack.
1341863.claim: SRE agents watch deploys and configuration changes and propose a rollback in Slack before an incident lands.
1341863.speaker: Karan Vaidya

1341863.quote: So to be able to do that correctly, you need to give right amount of access to all of these agents.
1341863.claim: Agents need broad reach across the company's apps but granular, scoped access to each one.
1341863.speaker: Karan Vaidya

1341863.quote: In case of non-deterministic agents, you want something similar protecting.
1341863.claim: Agents need a firewall on both what goes into them and what actions they take.
1341863.speaker: Karan Vaidya

1341863.quote: You don't want to have multiple agents looking at the same surface area because that can kind of conflict the context.
1341863.claim: Give each surface area one agent swarm, since several on the same surface conflict.
1341863.speaker: Karan Vaidya

1352199.quote: The company context is the key here.
1352199.claim: The AI tool a company adopts is the tip of the iceberg and changes fast; the lasting investment is the company context beneath it: enterprise skills, MCP servers and the harness.
1352199.speaker: Utkarsh Shrivastava

1352199.quote: Is another way for the agent to choose wrong.
1352199.claim: Every connector or tool added to a shared assistant is another way for the agent to pick the wrong source.
1352199.speaker: Utkarsh Shrivastava

1352199.quote: You would be very disappointed, but the tool was never wrong.
1352199.claim: Two connectors gave different viewer counts for the same live event (analytics vs. live transactional data); both were right, so the failure is choosing between sources, not any one tool.
1352199.speaker: Utkarsh Shrivastava

1352199.quote: The M C Ps have made it very cheap to make a lot of information accessible, but.
1352199.claim: MCP made connecting data cheap but left the ownership question unresolved: nobody settled which team's answer is authoritative.
1352199.speaker: Utkarsh Shrivastava

1352199.quote: And then finally, start with a solid twenty to fifty use cases.
1352199.claim: Domain teams should run a regression eval suite in CI on every change and model switch, starting from 20–50 real use cases, before adding a skill, plugin or connector.
1352199.speaker: Utkarsh Shrivastava

1352199.quote: For reversible writes, the stakes are higher than read.
1352199.claim: Gates should scale with stakes: reads are low risk, reversible writes higher, and irreversible actions like sending email or publishing numbers highest.
1352199.speaker: Utkarsh Shrivastava

1356697.quote: They are using as a source of truth for AI agents for questions about data.
1356697.claim: Leading companies connect their AI agents to the same modeled data stack that already serves business intelligence.
1356697.speaker: George Fraser

1356697.quote: You're presenting a simplified view of what is probably some very messy and complicated data.
1356697.claim: Modeling data into a simplified view is what makes it usable by AI, exactly as it was for human analysts.
1356697.speaker: George Fraser

1356697.quote: And you can't even do joins across sources, right?
1356697.claim: Connecting an assistant to each system of record through MCP fails for data questions, because it cannot join across sources.
1356697.speaker: George Fraser

1356697.quote: Local tables in a special schema, a map of the rest of the database that acts as a guide.
1356697.claim: Agents need a map: a small agent schema inside the database that describes the rest of it.
1356697.speaker: George Fraser

1356697.quote: And it's really convenient to have everything in one place.
1356697.claim: Keeping structured data, unstructured text and vector indexes in one database lets an agent write hybrid queries.
1356697.speaker: George Fraser

1356697.quote: The exact same skills that made them good at delivering analytics are going to make them good.
1356697.claim: The skills data teams built for analytics are the skills that make them good at providing context to AI.
1356697.speaker: George Fraser

1379134.quote: Let me just one more. Let me just one more, right?
1379134.claim: Half of surveyed developers keep prompting past the point they meant to stop, and it costs them sleep.
1379134.speaker: Scott Tolinski

1379134.quote: Reward system like a loot box on a video game, right?
1379134.claim: Prompting works like a variable reward, which is what makes it hard to put down.
1379134.speaker: Scott Tolinski

1379134.claim: Most developers feel pressure to produce more simply because AI makes it possible.
1379134.speaker: Scott Tolinski

1379134.claim: Running many agents at once multiplies the decisions a person must make and leads to decision fatigue.
1379134.speaker: Scott Tolinski

1379134.quote: So again, we start to form new pathways.
1379134.claim: Coding skills fade with AI use, but the brain forms new paths and much of what is lost no longer matters.
1379134.speaker: Scott Tolinski

1379134.quote: Less paralization makes for a calmer mind.
1379134.claim: Fewer agents in parallel, better habits and time away from screens are what help.
1379134.speaker: Scott Tolinski
